Meet The Team
Michelle Custead
Senior Medical Oncologist & Business Owner
Knowing that I have helped a family decide what is best for them and their pet while ensuring their pet maintains a good quality of life brings me great satisfaction.  In my free time, I enjoy reading, running, and snuggling with my cat, Lilly, with a cup of matcha.
Kayla Verdecchia
Senior Oncology Technician
I started my journey in Oncology 4 years ago. I love being able to bring some comfort to families in a very challenging time. I enjoy traveling and hiking with my husband and 2-year-old Collie named Faye. I also love relaxing with a good book and snuggling with my two cats, Gatsby and Doug.
Katie Lee
Technician
I am about to sit for my technician examination in the fall. During my time in oncology, I learned just how much I love veterinary medicine and helping pets and their owners. In my free time, I enjoy traveling with my fiancé and snuggling with my dogs, Oof and Archie.
Gabrielly Andrade
Veterinary Assistant
I have always had a love for animals and and have been interested in working in veterinary medicine for awhile. I finally took the leap to follow my dreams! I look forward to meeting you and your pets!
Beth Moore
Front Office Manager
I come to Ally with experience in numerous fields, including human medicine and pediatrics. I love being able to connect with pet owners and meet all the adorable dogs and cats. In my spare time, I savor every day with my son before he's all grown,n and I enjoy spending time with friends and loved ones.
Keith Miller
Administrative Assistant
My life is happily dictated by three cats — one who treats me like her personal heated mattress, and two Harry Potter fans who join me for movie nights a few times a month. I don't just love animals — I understand them, and I understand how to tell their stories in a way that makes people care. After years as a supervisor at BJ's Wholesale Club and Vinfen, I found my true calling at Ally Veterinary Specialty Center, where I serve as an Administrative Assistant—using media, marketing, Human Resources Support, IT Support, and outreach to connect busy animal hospitals with the communities that rely on them. I am building the clinic's digital presence from the ground up with beautiful, heartwarming recovery stories and educational campaigns that will transform the way we connect with our community. I am really looking forward to my future with this company.
Jennifer Lopez
Receptionist
I walked into Ally. I already knew that my mission was to care with compassion and support pets and their people through every stage of the journey. Listening carefully and treating you and your pet with purpose is my main goal from start to finish. Being a part of something so big has always been a childhood dream of mine
